abbott_smith_html:
πρέπω
[in LXX: Psa.93:5 (נָאָה pi.), etc. ;]
__1. to be clearly seen.
__2. to resemble.
__3. to be fitting or becoming, to suit: with dative, Heb.7:26, 1Ti.2:10, Tit.2:1; impers., with dative, Eph.5:3; id. before inf., Heb.2:10; πρέπον ἐστίν, with dative of person(s) and inf., Mat.3:15; with accusative and inf., 1Co.11:13 (see Bl., § 72, 5).†
(AS)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to tower up (be conspicuous), i.e. (by implication) to be suitable or proper (third person singular present indicative, often used impersonally, it is fit or right)

occurrences.bsb: “Let it be so now,” Jesus replied. “It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way.” Then John permitted Him.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.

occurrences.bsb: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
occurrences.kjv: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?

occurrences.bsb: But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.
occurrences.kjv: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;

occurrences.bsb: but with good deeds, as is proper for women who profess to worship God.
occurrences.kjv: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

occurrences.bsb: But as for you, speak the things that are consistent with sound doctrine.
occurrences.kjv: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:

occurrences.bsb: In bringing many sons to glory, it was fitting for God, for whom and through whom all things exist, to make the author of their salvation perfect through suffering.
occurrences.kjv: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

occurrences.bsb: Such a high priest truly befits us—One who is holy, innocent, undefiled, set apart from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.
occurrences.kjv: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
